title: Animals Metadata
description: Content contract for public/assets/animals.json. Each entry defines one playable animal. Adding/removing an entry (plus its image) changes the game roster without code changes (FR-005).

image.description: Path to the picture under assets/animals/, e.g. 'animals/cow.avif'.

soundWord.description: The sound shown on screen and spoken aloud in Learn mode. Use a natural, TTS-pronounceable spelling so speech reads it correctly, e.g. 'moo' (not 'muuuu').

acceptedAnswers.description: Spoken answers accepted as correct in Quiz mode (matched leniently, lowercased). e.g. ['muuu','moo','mooo'].

learnPhrase.description: Optional override for the Learn sentence. Default: 'The {name} says {soundWord}'.

quizPrompt.description: Optional override for the Quiz question. Default: 'What does the {name} say?'.
